**Summary:**
I investigated ticket T-4002 by checking the documents namespace and found that pdf-exporter pods are still running version 1.4.2 instead of the expected 1.5.0 update. The deployment is not rolling out to the new image. Since this requires deeper access to deployment status conditions and event logs to diagnose whether the issue is an image pull failure, a missing tag, or pod startup failure, I've escalated the ticket to a human engineer who can investigate further.
